translations.title: Loperamide Hydrochloride 2 mg Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to ease diarrhoea.
translations.usage: Adults take two capsules to start, then one more capsule each time they pass a loose stool, without going over the stated daily dose. Replace fluids and salts while taking it. If sudden diarrhoea has not improved within 48 hours, or long-lasting diarrhoea within 10 days, stop taking it and get advice.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, for babies under 2, for bacterial diarrhoea with blood in the stool or a high fever, or if you have sudden ulcerative colitis, pseudomembranous colitis, haemorrhagic colitis, a blocked bowel or megacolon, or an inherited condition that prevents you from digesting lactose. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you have liver problems, are elderly, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have HIV/AIDS. If you feel tired, dizzy or sleepy after taking it, take care when driving or operating machinery. If you are taking quinidine (for irregular heartbeat) or ritonavir (for HIV), talk to a pharmacist.

summaryTable.Who should be careful: Bacterial diarrhoea with blood or fever; blocked bowel; driving and machinery
